using System.Text.Json;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text;
using System.Diagnostics;
string tool = Path.GetFileNameWithoutExtension(Environment.ProcessPath!)!;
string trace = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("COR23Q_TRACE")!;
var entry = new { tool, args };
if (!(tool == "dotnet" && args.Length > 0 && args[0] == "run")) File.AppendAllText(trace, JsonSerializer.Serialize(entry) + Environment.NewLine);
int index = File.ReadLines(trace).Count();
int failAt = int.Parse(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("COR23Q_FAIL_AT") ?? "0");
int failCode = int.Parse(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("COR23Q_FAIL_CODE") ?? "47");
// A second independently selected failure witnesses teardown preserving the primary result.
int secondAt = int.Parse(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("COR23Q_SECOND_FAIL_AT") ?? "0");
if (index == failAt) return failCode;
if (index == secondAt) return 63;
if ((tool == "python3" || tool == "python") && args.Length > 1 && args[0].EndsWith("test-ownership.py") && args[1].StartsWith("api-"))
{
    string pidFile = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("COR23Q_API_PID")!;
    if (args[1] == "api-start")
    {
        var start = new ProcessStartInfo(Path.Combine(Path.GetDirectoryName(Environment.ProcessPath!)!, OperatingSystem.IsWindows() ? "dotnet.exe" : "dotnet"));
        start.ArgumentList.Add("run"); start.UseShellExecute = false;
        // Avoid inherited capture pipes: this test API has no diagnostics to publish.
        start.RedirectStandardOutput = true; start.RedirectStandardError = true;
        var child = Process.Start(start)!;
        File.WriteAllText(pidFile, child.Id.ToString());
        var deadline = DateTime.UtcNow.AddSeconds(5);
        while (DateTime.UtcNow < deadline)
        {
            try { using var probe = new TcpClient(); await probe.ConnectAsync(IPAddress.Loopback, 8080); break; }
            catch (SocketException) { await Task.Delay(20); }
        }
        Console.WriteLine(child.Id); return 0;
    }
    if (!File.Exists(pidFile)) return args[1] == "api-stop" ? 0 : 1;
    if (args[1] == "api-proof") return 0;
    try
    {
        using var child = Process.GetProcessById(int.Parse(File.ReadAllText(pidFile)));
        if (args[1] == "api-stop") { child.Kill(entireProcessTree: true); child.WaitForExit(5000); File.Delete(pidFile); return 0; }
        return child.HasExited ? 1 : 0;
    }
    catch (ArgumentException) { return args[1] == "api-stop" ? 0 : 1; }
}
if (tool == "dotnet" && args.Length > 0 && args[0] == "run")
{
    var server = new TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback, 8080); server.Start();
    while (true)
    {
        using var client = await server.AcceptTcpClientAsync(); using var stream = client.GetStream();
        var buffer = new byte[8192]; _ = await stream.ReadAsync(buffer);
        try { await stream.WriteAsync(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes("HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n")); } catch (IOException) { }
    }
}
if (tool == "docker" && args.Contains("--format"))
{
    string format = args[Array.IndexOf(args, "--format") + 1];
    Console.WriteLine(format.Contains("Server.Version") ? "28.0.0" : format.Contains("Endpoints.docker.Host") ? "unix:///owned-fixture.sock" : "{\"OSType\":\"linux\",\"OperatingSystem\":\"controlled fixture\"}");
}
else Console.WriteLine("fixture native output");
Console.Error.WriteLine("fixture native stderr with successful exit");
return 0;
